# Pyrexx AI

> Pyrexx AI is a HIPAA-compliant AI voice receptionist and clinical automation agency for private practice healthcare and wellness clinics in the US.

## Company
- Founded by: Clifford Bulya
- Headquarters: United States (Delaware incorporated)
- General Inquiries: hello@pyrexxai.com
- Client Support: support@pyrexxai.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/PyrexxAI

## Core Services

### 1. AI Voice Receptionist
- Done-for-you AI voice receptionist implementation (not a DIY SaaS tool)
- Live in 14 business days from kickoff to production
- Integrates with Jane App, Boulevard, Mindbody, Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, ChiroTouch, ModMed, DrChrono, Cliniko, eClinicalWorks, AthenaHealth, and custom systems
- Handles concurrent inbound calls with zero hold times
- Business Associate Agreement (BAA) executed before launch
- Pricing: $1,000 one-time initial implementation & EMR setup fee + $1,000/month (Overflow Plan: after-hours, weekends & breaks) or $1,500/month (Full-Time Plan: 100% 24/7 inbound coverage)

### 2. Patient Database Reactivation (Free Subscription Add-On)
- Automated SMS/Voice outreach to dormant patient lists
- Included FREE with every active AI Receptionist subscription

### 3. Website Building & AI Lead Intake
- Blazing fast, SEO-optimized clinical websites built on Next.js
- Sub-60s web and SMS lead qualification

## Target Private Practice Verticals
- Medical Spas (MedSpas)
- General & Cosmetic Dentistry
- Orthodontics & Clear Aligners
- Dermatology (Medical & Cosmetic)
- Chiropractic & Physical Therapy / Sports Rehab
- Behavioral Health & Therapy Practices
- Audiology & Hearing Aid Clinics
- Medical Weight Loss (GLP-1) & Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT)
